hook.name: HypersFunHook
hook.description: NAV-anchored tokenized-fund market hook on X Layer implementing a bonding curve (x*y=k) AMM for FUND/USDC swaps. The hook fully handles each swap by minting or burning FUND shares, collecting trading and exit fees, enforcing NAV-based price ceilings, and blocking external LP positions. hookData encoding the seller address and minOut slippage limit is required for sell swaps.
